details: Key public comment periods regarding stablecoin regulation under the GENIUS Act are concluding on June 2nd, with the Senate scheduled to resume discussions on the CLARITY Act on June 3rd. These legislative efforts aim to establish clearer rules for digital assets, define regulatory responsibilities, and determine permissible stablecoin models, including reserve requirements and the future of yield-bearing stablecoins. The outcomes could significantly shape the US crypto industry's growth and stability.
title: US Stablecoin Regulatory Deadlines Approach Amidst Legislative Push

details: Isabel Schnabel, a member of the European Central Bank (ECB) Executive Board, recently highlighted concerns that stablecoins could exacerbate run risk, weaken interest-rate transmission, and entrench dollar dominance. Her remarks come as the transition periods for the EU's Markets in Crypto-Assets Regulation (MiCA) are set to conclude on July 1, 2026, marking a significant step in the EU's comprehensive crypto regulatory framework.
title: ECB Warns on Stablecoin Risks as MiCA Transition Nears End

details: In the past week, the cryptocurrency market experienced a decline, with Bitcoin's price falling from nearly $78,000 to around $73,000. This downturn was attributed to a combination of macro pressures, including escalating geopolitical tensions between the US and Iran, which have dampened expectations for near-term interest rate cuts. Notably, US spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded over $1 billion in redemptions in a single day, indicating a significant decrease in institutional investor demand and contributing to a heightened risk-off sentiment.
title: Bitcoin Sees Outflows from Spot ETFs Amidst Macro Risks
